## Local Payment Methods

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/overview/): Local Payment Methods allow customers to pay with banks, wallets, or other means that operate only in specific regions of the world.
- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/configuration/): Before you can accept Local Payment Methods, you will need to ensure you have completed the following steps: 1.
- [Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/client-side-custom/): This will determine which PayPal credentials are used for the transaction, and **must** match the merchant account specified with any other calls in the transaction lifecycle…
- [Server-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/server-side/): [best practices guide](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/general/best-practices/ruby)to learn more.
- [Testing and Go Live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/testing-go-live/): Use your [Braintree sandbox API credentials](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/control-panel/important-gateway-credentials#api-credentials)and the test values on our
- [Boleto Bancário](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/boleto-bancario/): Boleto Bancário is currently in limited release and is only available to pilot merchants in Brazil. If you want to participate in the pilot, please
- [Multibanco](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/multibanco/): Multibanco is currently in limited release and is available to pilot merchants in any
- [OXXO](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/oxxo/): OXXO is currently in limited release and is only available to pilot merchants in Mexico. If you want to participate in the pilot, please
- [Trustly](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/trustly/): With Trustly, consumers can initiate payments directly from their bank accounts.
- [Swish](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/local-payment-methods/swish/): Swish is Sweden's leading mobile payment method, enabling instant bank transfers directly from customers' bank accounts.
